note: Version 2, 2026-10-12, from a page captured on the owner's phone (test/fixtures/echopark_results_captured.html) and the structure summary that tool/recipe_structure.dart printed for it: the card family is div.vehicleCardPaper (one /car link and one image each), the name is an h2, the price carries a data-testid, the page total sits in data-testid=inventoryCount beside the h1. Version 1 was guessed from rendered text and matched 66 elements with no title. Images are lazy (a v-lazy carousel per card): a page captured before scrolling has them on the first screen only, so the image fraction is a floor, not a verdict; the app's paced scroll is what makes the rest exist before a read. The year is a span of its own in the details row, in front of the mileage; the name heading has no year.
